name: create_purchase_request
title: Create purchase request
description: Raise a purchase request (PR): the internal ask to buy something. With confirm=false it previews the estimated value and who must approve; with confirm=true it saves and submits it. Within your limit it is approved at once; above it, it waits for your manager.

quantity.description: how many, in the item's unit

confirm.description: false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

policy.on_lost_write_reply: never resent blindly: look the document up (by its key or by what changed) and return it
policy.on_busy_before_write: ok=false with next_step; nothing was saved, so the same call is safe to repeat

release_notes.1.1: 3 Nov 2026 (Lecture 4 production-grade pass): need_by is checked and rewritten as YYYY-MM-DD at the door, so a retry that writes the date differently finds the first request instead of raising a second; quantity must be more than 0 (Ledgerline's pr_save saved, and auto-approved, 0 and negative quantities); output_schema: approver may be null.
